Requirement Text (Original Requirement): User shall be able to make payments securely through integrated payment gateways like PayPal, InterSwitch, etc.
The system shall be able to monitor the overall data processing rate, compare it to tolerances, and report any deviations from those tolerances.
All users shall be able to navigate to the Catalogue using the sub navigation icons.
The system shall render complex graphics and enable smooth on-screen navigation.
The system shall provide basic usage metrics for administrators
User shall be able to view the customer homepage after logging in.
The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.
The system shall allow the use of unverified (anonymous) avatars or aliases.
System shall provide a user-friendly web interface for depositors to submit and manage datasets without requiring additional software installation.
System shall enable sponsors to link attendees to their sponsorship page.
The system shall ensure safe transactions.
System shall restrict access to modules based on user roles, preventing students from updating marks.
System shall help police personnel in planning and executing tasks efficiently.
System shall use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0), and Yamaha codecs.
The system shall have sufficient hardware resources to support all functionalities of Adobe Illustrator without limitations due to insufficient hardware.
System shall allow browsing content by author or subject area.
User shall be able to interact with the text-based command-line interface of the system.
The automated diagnostic tool shall detect and identify certain performance and operational faults in chiller and cooling tower subsystems of HVAC units following specified algorithms.
System shall be able to provide access to the system through web browsers and mobile applications.
User shall experience a great UI and UX for a pleasant navigation experience.
System shall generate logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time, and changes, and fixed asset schedules.
Significant errors in software operation shall be logged to permanent storage with sufficient detail to guide the administrator and to assist support staff in locating and rectifying the error.
System shall provide secure passwords to each user or client.
The system shall support the following operating systems - Windows 10/11 (32-bit or 64-bit) and Windows Server 2022, Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, or Windows Server 2012 (including R2)
The system shall allow users to create unverified (anonymous) avatars or aliases.
The product shall be designed with very limited graphics usage and shall utilize a simple keypad for user input.

User shall be able to interact with databases using multiple interfaces such as the Command-Line Interface (CLI), Graphical User Interface (GUI) tools like MySQL Workbench, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for various programming languages.
User shall have an ALFRED device easily adaptable for users with visual or hearing impairments.
User shall access different modes for adding filters and effects to scenes and images, enhancing versatility and customization options.
User shall be able to respond to a limited number of profiles per day as a general job seeker.
The system shall allow authorized users to delete sub-apps and their launchers within the main application.
System shall have a strong network of servers managed by a qualified team to handle application functionality worldwide.
